about_the_game:
Subject: Supplementary Audio Program Deployment

Valued Operational Confiners,

To enhance efficiency across PhaigeX’s interstellar operations, a supplementary audio program is now active. Engineered by our Behavioral Optimization Division, this soundtrack is comprised of ten (10) dynamic and synchronize-ready tracks aimed at boosting focus for alignment with corporate objectives during navigation and extraction tasks.

The program is accessible for your free use during all duty cycles at your discretion. Division will be monitoring feedback and its impact on overall Confiner performance.

Towards a brighter future.

Colin Tremingway

Director of Auditory Engineering

The PhaigeX MegaCorp

---

Note: Report auditory issues to your supervisor. Unauthorized modifications are prohibited.

ADDENDUM:

Synchronize-ready means the tracks have the same form and structure. Implementation is such that various elements of several tracks are taken at a time to produce many various permutations of arrangement styles.
